svg.title: Kubernetes API access checks
svg.desc: Each request must pass all three authorization checks.

g.text: Each request must pass all three authorization checks.
Can this caller reach the API proxy?
A denied tailnet grant stops the request before it reaches Kubernetes.
May the proxy impersonate this identity?
May the caller perform the requested operation?
Network access and impersonation rights alone do not grant resource permissions.
Keep tailscale-k0s separate. Its admin client certificate connects directly
to a controller and does not depend on the API proxy.
